name: GEF
desc:
GEF is the name of an unidentified organism described by witnesses as a "Giant Evil Face". Nobody knows where these vicious creatures come from, but they have overrun the once-peaceful town that you now find yourself in. Escape is impossible. You can only survive.

•Search buildings for supplies
•Secure a base and board up windows before night falls...
•Defend yourself against the GEFs, and stay alive for as many days as you can!
